metadata.title: Regional and modelled hourly electricity-demand profile benchmarks for Botswana planning
metadata.warning: No benchmark profile is a Botswana measurement. GridIQ may normalize a benchmark shape and scale it to published Botswana peak/annual energy, but must preserve the benchmark/modelled evidence class.

sources.title: System hourly demand and available capacity
sources.use: regional hourly shape benchmark only; normalized before Botswana scaling

sources.title: GEGIS global hourly electricity-demand profiles
sources.use: fallback benchmark methodology; profile is scaled to country statistics in PyPSA-Earth

sources.publisher: Eskom / Stellenbosch University / University of Cape Town
sources.title: NRSLR Programme Domestic Electrical Load Study
sources.license_note: licensed non-commercial data files; not bundled in GridIQ
sources.use: future residential/community benchmark when licensed data are supplied

calibration_policy.shape: benchmark series is converted to a per-unit shape; original MW magnitude is discarded
calibration_policy.botswana_peak: scale per-unit shape to published Botswana peak demand
calibration_policy.botswana_energy: where annual calibration is requested, rescale so representative profile energy matches published Botswana annual supply
calibration_policy.never: do not call the resulting hourly series measured Botswana demand
